title: ExportRequest
description: Batch export of buildings of the reviewer's assignment (v0.3 §8.4; spec §11 r9; D-453). Each building is exported at its head version or skipped with a reason.
$comment: [P] Shape (D-455). The client sends the assignment's building ids; the check that each is in the signed assignment is 3D-25 (GT-23).
